GSTIN Validator

GSTIN Validator: free, instant and private. The last character is a checksum computed from the other fourteen, so a single mistyped character is caught immediately.

How the GSTIN Validator works

The GSTIN Validator takes GSTIN and returns the answer instantly — no button to hunt for, no page reload. The last character is a checksum computed from the other fourteen, so a single mistyped character is caught immediately. The PAN inside the GSTIN also tells you which legal entity owns the registration.

Enter your own numbers to replace the example values; the result panel updates as you type. Everything runs in this single page, so nothing you enter leaves your device.

Formula used

GSTIN = state code + PAN + entity number + Z + checksum

SymbolMeaning
state codefirst 2 digits — 27 Maharashtra, 29 Karnataka, 07 Delhi…
entity numberhow many registrations exist under the same PAN

The last character is a checksum computed from the other fourteen, so a single mistyped character is caught immediately. The PAN inside the GSTIN also tells you which legal entity owns the registration.

Inputs used: GSTIN.

Worked example

Take the default example — gstin of 29ABCDE1234F1ZW:

  • Verdict: true
  • Details: Karnataka · entity number 1 · PAN inside: ABCDE1234F
  • state: Karnataka
  • pan: ABCDE1234F
  • entity: 1

Frequently asked questions

What formula does the GSTIN Validator use?
It uses GSTIN = state code + PAN + entity number + Z + checksum, where state code is the first 2 digits — 27 Maharashtra, 29 Karnataka, 07 Delhi…; entity number is the how many registrations exist under the same PAN.
Is the GSTIN Validator free?
Yes. There is no signup, no usage limit and no watermark — the calculator runs entirely in your browser.
How do I read the result?
The last character is a checksum computed from the other fourteen, so a single mistyped character is caught immediately. The PAN inside the GSTIN also tells you which legal entity owns the registration.
Does the GSTIN Validator store or send my data?
No. Every calculation happens locally in the page, so the numbers you type are never uploaded or logged.
Does it work on a phone and offline?
Yes — the page is a single lightweight file that adapts to any screen size. Once it has loaded it keeps working without a network connection.
